title: Evidence-led Content Brief
summary: Validate a content topic with current search-demand signals and cited public sources, then produce a writer-ready brief with a supported angle, outline and measurable acceptance criteria.
outcome: A writer-ready brief with one primary topic, audience and intent, a supported angle, source-backed claims, outline, exclusions and measurable acceptance criteria.
boundary: The Skill does not write or publish the finished article, reproduce source text, invent statistics, present vendor claims as independent proof or expand research without approval.

catalog_tools.purpose: Validate demand, difficulty, intent and SERP context for a bounded topic set.
Retrieve current public sources that substantiate the brief's claims and angle.

inputs: A seed topic or business question
Audience, business objective and desired action
Country, language, exclusions and any required first-party sources
outputs: Cited claim ledger with source roles and cautions
Writer-ready brief with angle, outline, exclusions and acceptance criteria

cost.model: Inspected keyword-batch and web-search prices for one bounded validation and evidence pass.
cost.notes: Trial-safe mode validates at most five topics and retrieves at most five public sources in one search call; the exact inspected plan must remain at or below the stated maximum.

approvals: Approve the topic set, market, research query, requested result count, exact paid inputs and maximum total before the first metered run
Approve any second search, broader market, larger topic batch or additional provider
compatibility: One authorized Scrollport connection with apps, discover, inspect, run and wallet
A local file or conversation state for citations and the final brief
